reconciliation_note: Profit before income tax 340,421 - income tax 66,138 = profit for the year 274,283 (KShs'000). Operating Profit (EBIT) less Net Finance Costs plus Other Income equals Profit Before Tax does not hold in FY2025, FY2024: the statement bridges operating profit to profit before tax through further lines (Other Operating Income; Share of Profit of Equity-Accounted Investee) and the file's own bridge reproduces the filed profit before tax; both figures are shown unchanged.
